title: Verification code length
statement: Given a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet and natural-number parameters $d$ and $c$, define the verification code length at $n$ to be the code length of $N$ on input length $n$ with radius $2d(n+1)^c$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet
